description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types within the ChARM framework, categorizing them into two main groups: Virtual Characters and Real Characters. The chart is divided into multiple slices, with the largest segment representing "Comic Characters" in a light blue color, followed by "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," all of which are part of the "Virtual Characters" category. The "Real Characters" category includes smaller segments such as "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," each represented by distinct colors. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of virtual characters over real characters, with the "Virtual Characters" section occupying a significantly larger portion of the pie. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slices positioned at the top and the smaller ones towards the bottom right. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are clearly visible next to each slice, indicating the specific character types. The overall design uses a gradient of blue and green hues to differentiate between the two main categories, with the "Virtual Characters" in shades of blue and the "Real Characters" in shades of green.
